title: TMBB spaceships X account suspected to be McCasland
summary: Jesse Michels tells of TMBB spaceships X account suspected to be McCasland, about 2026 at Online (X), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: After his story broke, an online manhunt zeroed in on a potential smoking gun, an exac account called TMBB spaceships.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after the story of a general named McCasland broke in 2026, people online went hunting for clues about him. According to Michels, the hunt settled on an account called TMBB spaceships on X, the social media site, which some suspected McCasland himself was running. If so, it would be a possible smoking gun, a direct trace of the general speaking about spaceships.
